sections.appearance: Mika has long pink hair that shifts to a pale blue near the bottom and a bun tied to the right of her head. She has golden eyes. On her back are a pair of angel wings that sprout from around waist level. Halo ==== Her halo is comprised of two pink spirals that revolve around a central spherical piece with a ring below it. Three pink sparkles and a number of small blobs float just beyond the sparkles, making her halo resemble a protostar. She's one of the few students with a three-dimensional halo. Uniform ==== Mika wears a sleeveless white dress3rd PV that's frilled near the bottom and is inlaid with a starry print. She wears something that resembles a high-waisted skirt with two pairs of golden buttons, gold trimmings, and blue ribbons over this dress. The area above her bosom is a blue bow that's adorned with a golden cross button accessory on top. Like many members of the Tea Party, she wears a white capelet with golden trimmings. For legwear, she wears white pantyhose and black high heels with a ribbon on their back. Mika's bun is adorned with violet flowers. On her left wrist is a scrunchy with the same print as the inside of her dress. Her right wing is decorated with golden objects that hang from purple accessories, all of which resemble celestial bodies. sections.personality: She is a very talkative person, rarely particularly paying much mind to the current mood or flow of the conversation. She likes to interject her own, unfiltered thoughts into the current conversation. Unlike the other two presidents of the Tea Party, she is not particularly bright and can be viewed as a happy-go-lucky type of person. Even in serious situations, she often acts in a carefree manner, though it sometimes devolves into a mockery. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="border: 2px solid #FBB35A; text-align:left; width: 100%; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" ! style="background: #FBB35A; border: 1px solid #FBB35A; color: #000000; text-align:center; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" |Spoilers! |- | style="padding: 1%;" | However, Mika appears to suffer from a variant of Bipolar Disorder, as during her initial meeting with Sensei, she was so talkative that Nagisa had to threaten her in order to make room to speak and inform Sensei as to why they were called into Trinity.
